name: configure-prettier
description: Audit and propose repository-first Prettier configuration with explicit approval before any repository mutation.

interface.shortDescription: Audit and propose approval-gated Prettier changes.
interface.longDescription: Configure Prettier audits repository formatting evidence, resolves CLI and IDE behavior, and produces complete approval-gated plans for justified Prettier changes without modifying the target repository during discovery.
capabilities: CLI and VS Code parity analysis
defaultPrompt: Use Configure Prettier to audit this repository and propose an approval-gated Prettier plan.
